answer.text: Has no skin in the game
Establishes the vehicle — a REIT sponsor must hold a minimum stake as per SEBI norms, and an InvIT sponsor sets up the InvIT and contributes initial capital

explanation.text: The Logic: A REIT sponsor establishes the REIT and holds a minimum stake as per SEBI norms. An InvIT sponsor sets up the InvIT and contributes initial capital. The Trap: The other options misstate the sponsor's role — the sponsor has a defined skin-in-the-game and is not a government agency. Note: Sponsor responsibilities for REITs and InvITs are described in the XXI-A workbook.
